events.title: China proposes AI export restrictions and starts temporary registration
events.title_zh: 中国拟调整 AI 技术出口目录，并启动临时登记
organization: Ministry of Science and Technology of China
events.summary_en: China opened consultation on adding 40 technologies to its prohibited and restricted export catalogue, including 23 AI technologies spanning large models, agents, compute clusters and information processing. The catalogue changes are a draft, not final restrictions. A temporary pre-export registration requirement took effect on publication and applies until the revision is finalized.
events.summary_zh: 中国就技术出口目录新增 40 项技术征求意见，其中 23 项涉及大模型、agent、算力集群与信息处理。目录调整仍是草案，不是已经生效的最终限制。与此同时，出口前临时登记已从公告发布时生效，并持续到目录修订正式实施。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams transferring AI technology, licensing it abroad or planning overseas deployment, the live registration duty changes compliance work now, while final restricted scope remains unsettled. Public open-source releases and API/SaaS delivery have important stated boundaries.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对向境外转让、许可 AI 技术或规划海外部署的团队来说，已经生效的登记义务会立刻改变合规流程，但最终限制范围仍未确定。公开开源与 API/SaaS 交付有重要边界，不能把草案写成全面禁令。

technical_details.policy_stage: catalogue amendment is open for comment through 2026-11-15
technical_details.effective_measure: temporary pre-export registration effective 2026-10-16 16:00 China time
technical_details.stated_boundaries: public-domain open source and publications proposed excluded; API, SaaS, app and lightweight edge delivery are not by themselves technology export

technical_details_zh.已生效措施: 出口前临时登记自北京时间2026-10-16 16:00生效
technical_details_zh.官方边界: 公开领域的开源/论文拟排除；API、SaaS、App和轻量端侧交付本身不等于技术出口
technical_details_zh.时间依据: 官方页面标注北京时间2026-10-16 16:00

events.next_action_zh: 立即盘点跨境技术转让与海外部署，并在最终目录公布后按具体阈值重新评估。
events.next_action_en: Inventory cross-border technology transfers and overseas deployments now, then reassess against final thresholds when the catalogue is issued.
